hero.subtitle: I design conversational experiences with AI, where language and technology meet to create dialogues with purpose.

about.title: A crossing between disciplines.
about.paragraph_1: I'm Pedro Freitas, a professional in transition to Conversational UX Designer and AI Engineer. My path begins with listening — understanding how people say what they need — and matures in building: translating that listening into flows, prompts, and systems that respond with clarity.
about.paragraph_2: I work at the edge between conversation design and AI engineering. I design assistants in IBM Watson, prototype flows in Figma, write prompts that carry intent, and develop the integrations that sustain these experiences in production.
about.paragraph_3: I believe the best conversational interface is the one that disappears — when the technology steps back so the user's intention can speak louder.
